    , CASE
        WHEN Coalesce(Trim(C_CHTR.SOURCE_APP_CODE), '') <> '' 
			THEN C_CHTR.SOURCE_APP_CODE
        ELSE
--	********** Start Postgre Logic 01/24
			CASE 
                WHEN C_REPRINT.TRAN_DATE IS NOT NULL 
					THEN 'OTC'
				WHEN DEP_HTD.ENTRY_USER_ID IN ('CDCI', 'CDCI2') 
					AND Substring (DEP_HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR, 1, 3) = 'ATM' 
						THEN 'ATM'
				ELSE 'SYS'
            end
--	********** EndPostgre Logic 01/24

    , C_REPRINT.BNK_CODE C_REPRINT_BNK_CODE
    , C_REPRINT.FILE_NAME C_REPRINT_FILE_NAME
FROM EDS.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE DEP_HTD
LEFT JOIN eds.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE C_CHTR
    ON DEP_HTD.TRAN_DATE = C_CHTR.TRAN_DATE
    AND Trim(DEP_HTD.TRAN_ID) = Trim(C_CHTR.TRAN_ID)
    AND Trim(DEP_HTD.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM) = Trim(C_CHTR.PARTTRAN_NUM)
    AND DEP_HTD.BANK_ID = C_CHTR.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN eds.DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL C_REPRINT
    ON DEP_HTD.TRAN_DATE = C_REPRINT.TRAN_DATE
    AND Trim(DEP_HTD.TRAN_ID) = Trim(C_REPRINT.TRAN_ID)
    AND DEP_HTD.BANK_ID = C_REPRINT.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DF
    ON DF.GAM_ACID = DEP_HTD.ACID
    AND DF.AS_OF_DATE = DEP_HTD.TRAN_DATE
    AND DF.gam_bank_id = 'CBC01'
    --AND Substring(DF.GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
    --AND DF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
    AND DF.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = DF.CUST_ID
    AND CUST.BANK_ID = DF.gam_bank_id
    AND DF.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE 
	DEP_HTD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
	AND CAST(DEP_HTD.TRAN_DATETIME AS DATE) = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE)
